turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Good afternoon, I'm with the team that called about your water heater estimate.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks for coming, come on in.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: So tell me, what's prompting you to look into this now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly our old unit finally gave out last week.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: For the package we discussed, the total cost is $6,800.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We were planning to shop around a little more first.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Okay, well, the price is the price, but let me know if you change your mind.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Alright, well, feel free to reach out whenever you're ready.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Not sure yet, we'll be in touch.
